title.en: What do I measure about marketing, and what goes wrong?
title.zh: 我该衡量营销的什么？会出什么错？

description.en: Why marketing needs metrics, the funnel, return on marketing investment, three equities, and how a metric can quietly replace a strategy, with Who Gives a Crap and Coles.
description.zh: 为什么营销需要指标、漏斗、营销投资回报、三种资产，以及指标怎样悄悄取代战略，案例是 Who Gives a Crap 和 Coles。

name.en: Explaining and applying marketing metrics, ROMI and surrogation
name.zh: 解释并应用营销指标、ROMI 和替代偏差

description.en: hitting the metric means the strategy is working
description.zh: 达到指标就说明战略有效

description.en: return on marketing investment is just the extra revenue marketing brings
description.zh: 营销投资回报就是营销带来的额外收入

title.en: Twenty million dollars raised. For what?
title.zh: 筹到两千多万澳元。为了什么？

text.en: Who Gives a Crap’s own page says “We’ve raised \$20,887,792 to date” (the page gives no date), a number as clear as any. But the company’s purpose is not to raise money, it is that more people have clean water and toilets. A number that is easy to see can slowly **become the goal**.
text.zh: Who Gives a Crap 自己的页面写着“我们至今已筹集 20,887,792 澳元”（页面没有日期），这个数字再清楚不过。但公司的目的不是筹款，而是让更多人有干净的水和厕所。一个容易看见的数字，可能慢慢**变成目标**。

text.en: Marketing has the same problem on a larger scale. First, why does marketing need metrics at all?
text.zh: 营销有同样的问题，只是规模更大。先问：营销为什么要有指标？

prompt.en: A marketing team spends 100,000 and brings 300,000 of extra revenue at a 40% contribution margin. What is the return on marketing investment (ROMI)?
prompt.zh: 一个营销团队花 10 万元，带来 30 万元额外收入，贡献毛利率 40%。营销投资回报（ROMI）是多少？

feedback.en: That ignores the cost of the goods behind the extra revenue: the contribution margin.
feedback.zh: 那忽略了额外收入背后的商品成本：即贡献毛利。

label.en: +300%: the revenue divided by the spend

feedback.en: That is a ratio of revenue to spend, not a return.
feedback.zh: 那是收入对支出的比值，不是回报。

label.en: −60%: the margin is lower than the spend

explain.en: **ROMI = (incremental revenue × contribution margin − marketing spend) ÷ marketing spend.** Use the dial to see what drives it.
explain.zh: **ROMI =（增量收入 × 贡献毛利率 − 营销支出）÷ 营销支出。** 用转盘看看是什么在驱动它。

title.en: ROMI, and the funnel behind it

text.en: A purchase funnel narrows from awareness to consideration, trial and regular buying, and each stage has a different marketing tool. The numbers below are illustrations.
text.zh: 购买漏斗从知晓到考虑、试用、再到常规购买逐步收窄，每个阶段用不同的营销工具。下面的数字只是示意。

alt.en: Sliders for funnel conversion rates and marketing spend; outputs show how many buyers result, the extra revenue, and ROMI.
alt.zh: 漏斗各阶段转化率与营销支出的滑块；输出为最终买家数、额外收入和 ROMI。

label.en: Aware of the brand (of 10,000 target buyers)
label.zh: 知道这个品牌的比例（一万名目标买家中）
其中会考虑购买的比例
其中成为常规买家的比例

label.en: Extra revenue (500 a buyer a year)
label.zh: 额外收入（每位买家每年 500）

text.en: **Positive ROMI**: the margin from the extra revenue more than pays the spend.
text.zh: **ROMI 为正**：额外收入带来的毛利超过了支出。

text.en: **Negative ROMI**: the spend costs more than the margin it brings, whatever the awareness score.
text.zh: **ROMI 为负**：不管知晓度得分多高，支出比它带来的毛利更多。

label.en: Heavy advertising: awareness up, conversion low
label.zh: 重广告：知晓度高，转化低

caption.en: All numbers are illustrations to show how the funnel and ROMI connect; they are not data on any company.
caption.zh: 所有数字都是为说明漏斗和 ROMI 如何关联而设，不是任何公司的数据。

title.en: The metric that stands in for the strategy

text.en: A strategy is rarely measured directly; a metric stands in for it. Connect each strategy to a metric that represents it.
text.zh: 战略很少被直接衡量；总有一个指标代表它。把每个战略连到代表它的指标。

alt.en: Four strategies to connect to a metric that represents each (these are made-up illustrations).
alt.zh: 四个战略，连到各自的代表指标（为说明而编）。

label.zh: 战略：“建立让人信任的品牌”

label.en: Metric: brand attitude and perceived ethics in a tracker
label.zh: 指标：品牌追踪中的品牌态度与伦理认知

label.en: Metric: repeat purchase and loyalty-programme activity
label.zh: 指标：重复购买和忠诚计划活跃度

label.en: Metric: share of target buyers who have heard of us
label.zh: 指标：目标买家中听说过我们的比例

pairs.en: The metric stands for the strategy. It is not the strategy.
pairs.zh: 指标代表战略，但指标不是战略。

pairs.en: Brand equity: attitude, awareness, perceptions of ethics.
pairs.zh: 品牌资产：态度、知名度、对伦理的认知。

pairs.en: Relationship equity: the tendency to stick with the brand.
pairs.zh: 关系资产：对品牌黏着的倾向。

pairs.en: Awareness is the top of the funnel.

done.en: Each metric is a **representation** of the strategy. “Strategy is the blueprint for building an organisation; metrics are the concrete, wood, drywall and bricks.” Confuse them and you build to the bricks and forget the house.
done.zh: 每个指标都是战略的一种**代表**。“战略是建造组织的蓝图；指标只是混凝土、木头、石膏板和砖。”把它们混淆，你就会照着砖头盖房，却忘了房子。

no.zh: 那个指标衡量的是另一件事。

title.en: When does a metric replace the strategy?
title.zh: 指标什么时候取代战略？

text.en: This is **surrogation**: mentally replacing a strategy with its metric. It tends to happen when three conditions are met (Kahneman and Frederick). Three statements; say which condition each one is.
text.zh: 这就是**替代偏差**：在心里用指标取代战略。三个条件同时具备时，它最容易发生（Kahneman 和 Frederick）。三句话，说出各自是哪个条件。

alt.en: Three statements to tag with the condition of surrogation each describes.
alt.zh: 三句话，标出各自描述的是替代偏差的哪个条件。

label.en: The metric is concrete and conspicuous
Staff accept the swap, even without noticing
label.zh: 员工接受了替换，哪怕没意识到

why.en: A fuzzy goal: hard to see and hard to measure directly.
why.zh: 一个模糊的目标：难看见，也难直接衡量。

text.en: The weekly survey score is on every wall screen and in every meeting.
text.zh: 每周的问卷得分出现在每块墙屏和每次会议里。

why.en: A clear, visible number: it grabs attention.
why.zh: 一个清晰、可见的数字：很抓眼球。

text.en: Staff start asking customers for top scores, because that is what is rewarded.
text.zh: 员工开始央求顾客打高分，因为这才是被奖励的。

why.en: The metric has quietly replaced the goal in their minds.
why.zh: 指标已在他们心里悄悄取代了目标。

done.en: Three conditions: the **strategy is abstract**, the **metric is concrete and conspicuous**, and the **employee accepts the substitution**, at least subconsciously. To reduce the risk: **clarify the link between strategy and metrics, let the people who implement the strategy design the metric, loosen the link between metrics and incentives, use multiple metrics**.
done.zh: 三个条件：**战略抽象**、**指标具体而显眼**、**员工接受这种替换**，至少是下意识的。降低风险：**说清战略与指标的关系、让执行战略的人来设计指标、放松指标与激励的挂钩、使用多个指标**。

title.en: The framework, as the marker wants it

text.en: **Why marketing metrics**: marketers must justify spending, and metrics complement EVA and the scorecard because they are customer-centric. Marketing investments (relationship marketing, advertising, promotions) change **market results** (awareness, consideration, intent, purchase, loyalty, penetration of key segments), which change **financial results** (unit sales, price premium, market share, then EVA, ROI and shareholder value). The funnel moves from **awareness** (mass media, outdoor, search) through **consideration** (mass media, promotions, sampling), **trial** (pricing, occasional promotions), **regular buyers** (pricing, retention, targeted post-purchase communication) to **penetration**. Five questions, five perspectives (Best): awareness, preference, intention, availability, purchase.
text.zh: **为什么需要营销指标**：营销人员必须为支出辩护，而指标之所以能补充 EVA 和计分卡，是因为它们以顾客为中心。营销投入（关系营销、广告、促销）改变**市场结果**（知晓、考虑、意向、购买、忠诚、关键细分的渗透），再改变**财务结果**（销量、价格溢价、市场份额，进而 EVA、ROI 和股东价值）。漏斗从**知晓**（大众媒体、户外、搜索）经**考虑**（大众媒体、促销、试用装）、**试用**（定价、临时促销）、**常规买家**（定价、保留、针对性的购后沟通）到**渗透**。五个问题、五个视角（Best）：知晓、偏好、意向、可得、购买。

body.en: **ROMI** = (incremental revenue × contribution margin − marketing spend) ÷ marketing spend; it guides trade-offs between competing investments such as advertising, product quality or loyalty programmes. Marketing investment builds three **equities** (Rust, Lemon and Zeithaml): **value equity** (the objective assessment of what is received for what is given: quality, price, convenience), **brand equity** (the subjective, intangible assessment beyond that: awareness, attitude, ethics; Interbrand values brands, and a corporate scandal, such as Volkswagen’s emissions case from 2015, can cut a brand’s rank for years) and **relationship equity** (the extra tendency to stick with the brand: loyalty programmes, affinity, community). The financial value of marketing is largely the result of creating customer value.
body.zh: **ROMI** =（增量收入 × 贡献毛利率 − 营销支出）÷ 营销支出；它帮助在广告、产品质量或忠诚计划等相互竞争的投资之间取舍。营销投入建立三种**资产**（Rust、Lemon 和 Zeithaml）：**价值资产**（对所得与所付的客观评估：质量、价格、便利）、**品牌资产**（超出前者的主观无形评估：知名度、态度、伦理；Interbrand 给品牌估值，企业丑闻，如 2015 年起的大众排放事件，会让品牌排名多年下滑）和**关系资产**（超出前两者的黏着倾向：忠诚计划、亲和力、社群）。营销的财务价值在很大程度上是创造顾客价值的结果。

text.en: **Customer lifetime value (CLV)** and **customer equity** are forward-looking, customer-centric metrics, and customer equity can stand as a proxy for firm value. **Measurement issues**: measuring the wrong things (rewarding A while hoping for B), missing important data or using poor measures (fascination with an objective criterion, such as call attempts), and **surrogation**.
text.zh: **顾客终身价值（CLV）**和**顾客资产**是面向未来、以顾客为中心的指标，顾客资产可以作为企业价值的代理。**衡量问题**：衡量了错误的东西（奖励 A，却期望 B）、遗漏重要数据或使用不佳的指标（迷恋客观标准，如拨打电话次数），以及**替代偏差**。

prompt.en: Use Who Gives a Crap’s dollar tally as the metric and “more people with clean water and toilets” as the strategy. Write four sentences: **which of the three surrogation conditions** are present, how the tally could replace the strategy, and **one** extra metric to loosen the link. True facts: the tally (AUD 20,887,792, undated), 50% of profits, 575,082 people given access to improved water, sanitation and hygiene (2023, reported by WGAC).
prompt.zh: 把 Who Gives a Crap 的金额累计数当作指标，把“让更多人用上干净的水和厕所”当作战略。写四句话：三个替代偏差条件中**哪几个**存在、累计数怎样可能取代战略，以及**一个**额外指标来放松这种联系。真实事实：累计数（20,887,792 澳元，无日期）、50% 利润、575,082 人获得改善的水、环卫与个人卫生服务（2023 年，WGAC 自己报告）。

key_points.en: Says the strategy is abstract and the tally is concrete and conspicuous
key_points.zh: 说明战略抽象，而累计数具体而显眼

key_points.en: Says the risk is that staff or marketing treat dollars raised as the goal, when dollars are not people reached
key_points.zh: 说明风险是员工或营销把筹到的钱当作目标，而钱不等于惠及的人

key_points.en: Proposes a second metric such as people reached (575,082 in 2023) or the verified outcome of projects
key_points.zh: 提出第二个指标，如惠及的人数（2023 年 575,082）或项目经核实的成果

key_points.en: Says the tally has no date, so it cannot show progress
key_points.zh: 说明累计数没有日期，所以无法显示进展

model_answer.en: Two conditions are present: the strategy, more people with clean water and toilets, is abstract, and the dollar tally of AUD 20,887,792 is concrete and conspicuous on the company’s page; the third, acceptance by staff, I cannot tell. The tally could replace the strategy if teams start to optimise dollars raised, for example by pushing sales, when money is not the same as people helped. The tally is also undated, so it cannot show progress. A second metric should sit beside it: people reached, which WGAC reported as 575,082 in 2023, and the verified outcome of projects, which together loosen the link to one number.
model_answer.zh: 有两个条件存在：战略（让更多人用上干净的水和厕所）是抽象的，而 20,887,792 澳元的金额累计数在公司页面上具体而显眼；第三个条件（员工的接受），我无法判断。如果团队开始优化“筹到的钱”，比如猛推销售，累计数就可能取代战略，而钱并不等于被帮助的人。这个累计数还没有日期，所以无法显示进展。旁边应该放第二个指标：惠及的人数，WGAC 报告 2023 年为 575,082，以及项目经核实的成果，这样就能放松对单一数字的依赖。

explain.en: Name the conditions, the swap, and one extra metric.
explain.zh: 说出条件、替换，以及一个额外指标。

prompt.en: A team reports record awareness after a big advertising campaign, and ROMI is negative. What does that show?
prompt.zh: 一个团队在大型广告活动后报告知晓度创纪录，而 ROMI 为负。这说明什么？

label.en: Awareness is a market result near the top of the funnel; it does not by itself create financial value
label.zh: 知晓度是漏斗上端的市场结果；它本身不创造财务价值

label.en: The campaign worked, so ROMI is wrong
label.zh: 活动成功了，所以 ROMI 算错了

feedback.en: ROMI includes the cost of the spend; success on awareness can still lose money.
feedback.zh: ROMI 包含了支出的成本；知晓度上的成功仍可能亏钱。

label.en: Awareness and ROMI are the same measure
label.zh: 知晓度和 ROMI 是同一个指标

feedback.en: One is a market result, the other a financial return.
feedback.zh: 一个是市场结果，一个是财务回报。

explain.en: Market results and financial results are different links in the chain.
explain.zh: 市场结果与财务结果是链条上不同的环节。

prompt.en: From lesson 14: EVA differs from the Balanced Scorecard because EVA…
prompt.zh: 来自第 14 课：EVA 与平衡计分卡不同，因为 EVA……

label.en: reports outcomes after a capital charge, looking backward
label.zh: 报告扣除资本成本后的结果，回头看

prompt.en: From lesson 11: the intention-action gap means…
prompt.zh: 来自第 11 课：意图与行动的落差是指……

label.en: shoppers say they prefer ethical products, but many buy on price
label.zh: 购物者说偏好道德产品，但许多人按价格购买

label.en: shoppers always act on their values
label.zh: 购物者总是按价值观行动

explain.en: A reason survey metrics can mislead.
explain.zh: 也是问卷指标可能误导的原因。

prompt.en:
Question. (a) Explain why firms need marketing metrics and the surrogation problem. (b) Apply the ideas to Who Gives a Crap in Australia. (c) Make two recommendations.

Explain (5 marks). Exceeds: precise, thorough, clear, with the right terms. Meets: accurate, key points present, a little shallow.

Write the **Explain** part.
prompt.zh:
题目。(a) 解释企业为什么需要营销指标，以及替代偏差问题。(b) 把这些概念应用到澳大利亚的 Who Gives a Crap。(c) 给出两条建议。

解释（5 分）。优秀：精确、完整、清楚，用对术语。达标：准确、要点齐全，但深度略浅。

写**解释**部分。

key_points.en: Metrics link marketing investment to market results and financial results; ROMI formula
key_points.zh: 指标把营销投入和市场结果、财务结果联系起来；ROMI 公式
三种资产：价值、品牌、关系

key_points.en: Surrogation: replacing strategy with its metric
key_points.zh: 替代偏差：用指标取代战略

key_points.en: The three conditions and how to reduce the risk
key_points.zh: 三个条件以及降低风险的办法

model_answer.en: Marketing metrics link marketing investment to market results, such as awareness and loyalty, and then to financial results, so marketers can justify spending; return on marketing investment is incremental revenue times contribution margin, less spend, divided by spend. Marketing builds value, brand and relationship equity. Surrogation is the subconscious replacement of a strategy by its metric. It tends to occur when the strategy is abstract, the metric concrete and conspicuous, and staff accept the swap. Firms reduce it by clarifying the link between strategy and metrics, involving implementers in designing metrics, loosening links to incentives and using several metrics.
model_answer.zh: 营销指标把营销投入与知晓、忠诚等市场结果联系起来，再联系到财务结果，所以营销人员能为支出辩护；营销投资回报是增量收入乘以贡献毛利率，减去支出，再除以支出。营销建立价值资产、品牌资产和关系资产。替代偏差是用指标下意识地取代战略。它倾向于在战略抽象、指标具体而显眼、员工接受这种替换时发生。企业通过说清战略与指标的关系、让执行者参与设计指标、放松指标与激励的挂钩、使用多个指标来降低风险。

explain.en: Compare with the key points and the model answer. A scoring answer says the thing, shows it on this company, and stops.
explain.zh: 对照要点和参考答案。拿分的答案：把概念说准，落到这家公司上，然后收住。

prompt.en:
Question. (a) Explain why firms need marketing metrics and the surrogation problem. (b) Apply the ideas to Who Gives a Crap in Australia. (c) Make two recommendations.

Apply (10 marks). Exceeds: this company, rigorous cause and effect, evidence from the case. Meets: correct and logical, connections could go deeper.

Write the **Apply** part.
prompt.zh:
题目。(a) 解释企业为什么需要营销指标，以及替代偏差问题。(b) 把这些概念应用到澳大利亚的 Who Gives a Crap。(c) 给出两条建议。

应用（10 分）。优秀：针对这家公司，因果分析严密，有案例证据。达标：应用正确、逻辑通顺，但联系还可以更深。

写**应用**部分。

key_points.en: Uses true facts: tally AUD 20,887,792 undated, 50% of profits, 575,082 people (2023), B Corp
key_points.zh: 用真实事实：累计数 20,887,792 澳元、无日期；50% 利润；575,082 人（2023）；B Corp

key_points.en: Applies surrogation conditions to the tally with cause and effect
key_points.zh: 把替代偏差条件应用到累计数上并说明因果

key_points.en: Applies the equities (brand equity from B Corp and giving, value equity from price, relationship equity)
key_points.zh: 运用三种资产（B Corp 与捐赠带来的品牌资产、价格带来的价值资产、关系资产）

model_answer.en: Who Gives a Crap’s own strategy is that more people have water and sanitation, and its public metric is the dollar tally of AUD 20,887,792, undated. That meets two surrogation conditions, an abstract strategy and a concrete, conspicuous metric, so there is a risk that dollars become the goal. A people-based metric, 575,082 reached in 2023, sits closer to the strategy. Equities: brand equity comes from the giving and B Corp certification, which shape perceptions of ethics; value equity is weaker because the price is at or above budget brands; relationship equity depends on repeat buying, which the company’s direct online model can observe. Each metric stands for something, so the company should read them together.
model_answer.zh: Who Gives a Crap 自己的战略是让更多人有水和卫生设施，它的公开指标是 20,887,792 澳元的金额累计数，没有日期。这满足两个替代偏差条件：抽象的战略和具体显眼的指标，所以存在“钱变成目标”的风险。以人为单位的指标（2023 年惠及 575,082 人）更贴近战略。三种资产：品牌资产来自捐赠和 B Corp 认证，塑造了伦理认知；价值资产较弱，因为价格不低于平价品牌；关系资产取决于重复购买，公司的线上直销模式能观察到。每个指标都代表某种东西，所以公司应该把它们放在一起读。

explain.en: Compare with the key points and the model answer. A scoring answer says the thing, shows it on this company, and stops.
explain.zh: 对照要点和参考答案。拿分的答案：把概念说准，落到这家公司上，然后收住。

prompt.en:
Question. (a) Explain why firms need marketing metrics and the surrogation problem. (b) Apply the ideas to Who Gives a Crap in Australia. (c) Make two recommendations.

Recommend (5 marks). Exceeds: exactly two, realistic, strategic, actionable, each following from your analysis, with a risk named. Meets: sound but thin on how.

Write the **Recommend** part: exactly two.
prompt.zh:
题目。(a) 解释企业为什么需要营销指标，以及替代偏差问题。(b) 把这些概念应用到澳大利亚的 Who Gives a Crap。(c) 给出两条建议。

建议（5 分）。优秀：恰好两条，现实、有战略性、可执行，都从你的分析里推出来，并点出风险。达标：合理，但“怎么做”偏薄。

写**建议**部分：恰好两条。

key_points.en: Exactly two from the analysis (add a people-based, dated metric; track repeat purchase for relationship equity)
key_points.zh: 恰好两条，从分析里推出（增加以人为单位、有日期的指标；追踪重复购买作为关系资产）

model_answer.en: First, publish the number of people reached and the verified outcome of projects next to the dollar tally, each with a date, because the tally alone is abstract strategy against a concrete metric. The risk is slow or uncertain partner data, so state how the numbers are verified. Second, track repeat purchase and the share of buyers who return, because relationship equity shows whether the segment keeps following through. The risk is that repeat rate becomes the new target, so keep it beside the impact numbers.
model_answer.zh: 第一，在金额累计数旁边公布惠及的人数和项目经核实的成果，并各注明日期，因为单靠累计数就是“抽象战略对具体指标”。风险是合作伙伴的数据慢或不确定，所以要说明这些数字怎样核实。第二，追踪重复购买和回头买家的占比，因为关系资产显示这个细分是否持续付诸行动。风险是回购率变成新的目标，所以要把它和影响力数字放在一起。

explain.en: Compare with the key points and the model answer. A scoring answer says the thing, shows it on this company, and stops.
explain.zh: 对照要点和参考答案。拿分的答案：把概念说准，落到这家公司上，然后收住。
